title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-11
source: Master soundboard reels > DAT > CD > Plextor PX-708A extraction (EAC v0.95 prebeta 5) > tracking (CD Wave) > sector boundary verification (shntool v2.0.3) > .flac encoding (flac v1.1.0)

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard capture of a scorching Dark Star → Spanish Jam → Lovelight sequence featuring legendary guests and crystal‑clear mix.
ai_review.review: The patched soundboard release delivers an exceptionally clear picture of one of the wildest early‑70s jams, with Dark Star flowing into a blistering Spanish Jam and a surreal Lovelight where Gregg Allman trades vocals. Guest appearances by Peter Green, Duane Allman, Mick Fleetwood and multiple drummers create a “coherent free‑for‑all” that reviewers hail as one of the hottest shows ever recorded.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen reviews overwhelmingly praise both performance and audio clarity; weighted average (70% show, 30% recording) yields an almost perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as superb and crystal‑clear; patches fill missing segments but do not detract from overall fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A high‑energy, free‑form jam session with seamless transitions and a remarkable guest roster that keeps the momentum blazing from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his tone and noted experimentation with single‑coil guitars; interacts playfully with Phil before the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Startled by Duane’s slide on Dark Star, steps back during Lovelight to listen, and enjoys the guest jam atmosphere.
band_member_comments.Keys: Gregg Allman’s organ work highlighted as a key texture; Peter Green’s guitar adds an extra layer of excitement.
band_member_comments.Drums: Butch joins on drums, Mickey unleashes his massive gong, and multiple drummers create a thunderous rhythmic foundation.
